text.autoconfig.aun.title: A-U-N Settings
text.autoconfig.aun.option.general.modEn: Globally toggle all AUN features ON or OFF.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.general.toggl: Key to quickly toggle AUN features.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.general.profi: Select Default, ON, OFF, or Own Profile.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.general.custo: Click to select a custom profile configuration file from your computer.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.clearVision.c: Removes underwater fog for clear vision.
Removes under-lava fog so you can see clearly in lava.
Removes the thick fog when inside powdered snow.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.worldSettings: Adds a Favourite button in the World Selection menu: 1x = Gold, 2x = Diamond, 3x = Classic.
Displays your total hours played next to the last-played date.
Moves deleted worlds into saves/_deleted_worlds_bin instead of permanently deleting them.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.entities.reac: Right-click an item frame to open the container behind it.
Right-click a wall sign to open the container behind it.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.entities.armo: Crouch and right-click an armor stand to swap your armor with it.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.entities.hors: Shows your horse's speed and jump height inside the empty box in the horse inventory.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.entities.dism: Right-click any mob in a boat or minecart to dismount it.
Items from blocks you mine go straight into your inventory.
On a ladder, look up to climb up automatically and look down to climb down.
Automatically puts a new Totem of Undying into the hand where your totem popped.
Moves a tool with 1 durability left from your hotbar into your inventory so it cannot break.
Automatically selects the fastest hotbar tool when mining a block.
Right-click a grown crop to harvest and replant it (hoes harvest larger areas).
text.autoconfig.aun.option.playerHud.sta: Replaces a consumed stack in your hand with a matching stack from your inventory.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.playerHud.bet: Press F1 once to hide only the HUD while keeping your hand visible; press F1 again for vanilla F1.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.playerHud.bun: Expands the bundle tooltip grid to show all items inside.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.playerHud.hid: Toggles armor visibility via the eye button in the inventory and reveals armor for 5s on damage.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.playerHud.rai: Raises the hotbar above the bottom edge of the screen with a clean gap.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.playerHud.hea: Replaces locator bar dots with 8x8 player heads synced to camera rotation.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.playerHud.loc: Locator Bar Combination (Merge With XP Bar)
Combines the Locator Bar into the XP Bar so the XP bar is always visible and player dots/heads render over it.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.playerHud.cha: Renders each player's 8x8 skin face before their name in chat.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.playerHud.hid: Hides your own potion effect particles in first-person view.
Hides your own potion effect particles in third-person view.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.playerHud.cen: Centers the crosshair accurately on even screen widths.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.remainingHuds: Disables the Ctrl+B narrator shortcut and narrator popups completely.
Prevents the Advancements keybind from opening the advancements screen.
Hold your Sprint keybind (Shift) and press Drop (Q) on a slot to drop all matching items across your inventory.
Increases the maximum chat history from 100 messages to 1000 messages.
Click and drag across any sent message in chat to highlight it, then press Ctrl+C to copy.
Right-click an ingredient in the crafting grid to switch the Recipe Book to that item's recipe.
Turn pages in a book with the mouse wheel.
Hold Zoom key to smoothly zoom in, and scroll the mouse wheel to zoom closer or further.
Key to hold for Zoom (default C).
Holding torches, lanterns, or glowing items illuminates surrounding blocks.
Adds a search box to Chests, Shulkers, Barrels, and Ender Chests to filter items by keyword.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.commands.neth: Type /nethercalc in chat to calculate matching Nether or Overworld portal coordinates.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.screenSetting: Removes the compatibility confirmation popup when enabling resource packs.
Reloads only language files when changing languages.
Returns to the title menu immediately while your world saves in the background.
Removes the fade-out delay when the loading screen finishes.
Uses borderless fullscreen so clicking on a second monitor does not minimize Minecraft.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.cutThrough.@T: Hit mobs standing behind tall grass and plants.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.doubleDoors.@: Opening or closing one door of a double door also moves the other one.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.fastLeafDecay: Leaves vanish quickly after cutting down a tree.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.fullbright.@T: Toggles full brightness without changing Nether sky colors.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.facingPlaceme: Hold the keys below to orient placed blocks into or away from the clicked block face.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.noAccidentalL: Prevents stripping logs when holding an offhand item or holding right-click continuously.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.accurateBlock: Makes placing lines of blocks smooth while holding right-click.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.enchantmentDe: Shows what each enchantment does beneath its name on item tooltips.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.happyGhast.sp: Master toggle for Happy Ghast Speed potion boost.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.happyGhast.ho: Enables horizontal flying speed boost when affected by Speed.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.happyGhast.ve: Enables vertical flying speed boost when affected by Speed.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.essential.glo: Makes armor trim pixels shine in the dark like Glow Squids without emitting block light.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.essential.cor: Right-click any dead coral block, plant, or fan with a Water Bottle to revive it.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.essential.mor: Enables crafting red dye from redstone, black dye from coal, and dyes from corals.
text.autoconfig.aun.option.stackingXp.@T: Merges nearby XP orbs into larger single orbs to improve performance.
key.aun.face_into: Place Block Facing Into Clicked Face
key.aun.face_away: Place Block Facing Away From Clicked Face
gamerule.aun.macenerfdmgplayer.descripti: A mace smash from a player always deals exactly 1 HP to another player.
